experiments.conditions: MOERI/KRISO towing-tank open-water test of the 250 mm model (scale 31.6). Rate of revolution and water temperature are NOT given in the published archive: rpm 1080 (18 rps) and nu 1.14e-6 are ASSUMPTIONS (Re(0.7R) ~ 8e5); coefficients do not depend on them except through Re.
experiments.source: KCS_prop_MOERI.zip / openwater.txt (Tokyo 2015 CFD workshop archive; same data in CFDWS2010 and SIMMAN2014), tabulated
experiments.uncertainty: tabulated to 3 decimals; measurement uncertainty not published

experiments.conditions: NMRI No.3 towing tank, 104.6 mm model of the same geometry, n = 32 rps, 22.2 C, Rn = nD^2/nu = 3.68e5, immersion 1.5 D. The defaults are REYNOLDS-EQUIVALENT for the 250 mm case geometry: rpm 336.2 = 32 rps x (0.1046/0.25)^2 x 60, nu from the stated Rn - they reproduce the 104.6 mm model's chord Reynolds numbers (Re(0.7R) ~ 3e5). A low-Re comparison: KT about 3-6 % above the MOERI data at the same J.
experiments.uncertainty: tabulated to 4 decimals; source warns 'KQ data are only as a guide due to the small size propeller'

sources.citation: Tokyo 2015: A Workshop on CFD in Ship Hydrodynamics, KCS geometry and conditions page; archive KCS_prop_MOERI.zip (propgeom.txt, openwater.txt; KRISO/MOERI) and KP505.zip (IGES/STEP model, courtesy of KRISO).
SIMMAN 2008 workshop, KCS geometry page: KCS Propeller (MOERI model), KCS propgeom NMRI.zip, KCS_POT_NMRI.zip.

Fujisawa J., Ukon Y., Kume K., Takeshi H. (2000). Local velocity field measurements around the KCS model (SRI M.S. No. 631) in the SRI 400 m towing tank. Ship Performance Division Report No. 00-003-02, Ship Research Institute, Tokyo (cited as the origin of the KP505 open-water data; not obtained).
Brockett T. (1966). DTMB Report 1780, Tables 1 and 3 (NACA 66 (mod) thickness, a=0.8 mean line).

notes: Modern merchant-ship propeller: P/D peaks at 1.013 (0.6R) and is unloaded at root and tip; AE/A0 0.80; hub d/D 0.18 (Rhub = 0.18R, the table starts there). SKEW 32 deg (balanced) is not representable in BEM - expect a small bias. Sections: KRISO states 'NACA66 thickness form + a=0.8 mean line'; the DTMB-modified NACA 66 ordinates are used (the standard choice; the unmodified 66 differs only near LE/TE). Polars computed with XFOIL at Re 1e5-1.5e6. Tip row: the source has C/D = 0.0001 and fo/C = 8.7 (meaningless), handled as zero chord with the 0.95R section. Two independent tests of the same geometry at different Re (MOERI 250 mm; NMRI 104.6 mm) give a Reynolds-sensitivity check. The NMRI file's J=0.7 appears twice (repeat point). Rows with negative KT at J = 1.05 are kept (eta negative there).
